metadata.title: अंगारमोती मड़ई | आदिवासी न्यूज़ बुलेटिन | weekly tribal bulletin
metadata.description: Today's bulletin begins with the unique tradition of the Angarmoti Temple in Chhattisgarh. Following that, we'll dive into the Jharkhand Assembly elections, exploring how closely the manifestos of the BJP and JMM align with the real issues faced by Jharkhand's tribal communities. We'll also cover the ongoing struggle for tribal rights. Additionally, news from tribal regions of Tripura and Madhya Pradesh will be featured in the bulletin.
